name: TicTacToe
description: A simple tic-tac-toe game in a panel that is always shown on the SUPER DESKTOP desktop: play the computer or a friend, with a saved score. A small # in the top bar reopens it; turn the plugin off in Settings → Plugins to hide it.

surfaces.tooltip: Tic-tac-toe · always on the desktop (turn it off in Settings → Plugins)
